messages.text: Not looking for order. Looking to do RMA. I requested one last week from another email address of mine and heard nothing. (email hidden) is the other email address. Can I please get help with shipping this BSB NerdOctaxe back to you?

Hi, I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist.

Happy to help. Before anything ships anywhere I need to validate the fault, that's my part of an RMA, so one question first:

What exactly is the NerdOctaxe doing? For example: no power at all, screen blank, boots but zero chips / no hashrate, an error on the screen, or something physical (fan, screen, damage)?

If there's an error message or code on the display or in the web UI, tell me the exact wording and I'll look it up for that model and firmware.
Sammuel S., (address hidden), Henderson NV (postal code ····)

Thanks, but I don't need an address from me side, and I won't repeat personal details here.

What I still need is the fault itself, so I can validate the RMA:

1. What does the NerdOctaxe do when you plug it in? (nothing at all, screen lights but no hashing, error on screen, fans only)
2. Any error text or code on the display or in the web UI? Exact wording helps.

One line on that and I can move this forward.
(The customer sent this photo without a message.)
Verdict recorded and the chat is back with support.
